of.needed: which installation paths or existing CRD conversion settings trigger the Forbidden spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig error when applying 0.16.0

original.statement: Installing or upgrading to 0.16.0 can fail with "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook"; upstream says to use 0.16.1 instead, where this is fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-0eb3d16492e3] is a troubleshooting entry under "Guide to Promoting to 0.16", so it is about upgrades from releases before 0.16. That supports the edge-from-version out-of-range ">=0.16.0" operand. The entry gives a workaround (use 0.16.1) but does not say which installation paths or existing CRD states trigger the Forbidden error. The rendered diffs ([ev-558ba9e85f76], [ev-7a082965d61c] and others) show spec.conversion removed from the chart CRDs, but no source links that removal to the error. Combining the version bound with an undecidable evidence-gap operand captures what the evidence supports without over- or under-claiming.
